preconditions.description: N and M are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The coordinates (i, j) are within the valid range for the MxM section.

postconditions.expression: all(first_map[i + k][j:j + M] == second_map[j + k][i:i + M] for k in range(M))
postconditions.description: The MxM section in the first map starting at (i, j) matches the MxM section in the second map starting at (j, i).
